reference_adapter: The source release has architecture inkling2 and 48 logical layers, with 24 physical weight sets. The [Q,K,V,FFN] message queries are reconstructed from loop_res_query and loop_kv_res_query. No checkpoint payload is requantized.
scope: Still-image encoder plans (vision.rs, image.rs) follow the reference's image path. Text execution runs the vendored decode step (crates/lisa-metal/src/shaders/reference/, its own provenance.json); no checkpoint payload is requantized. See specs/models/inkling2.md.

dflash2_draft.reference_integration: The checkpoint's sglang_inkling_dflash2.py: features are the inputs to visits 5, 23 and 41 and the final-norm output; block rows use the target's normalized embedding rows; the selector softcap applies after the edge correction; candidates are limited to the 200,058 valid tokens.
dflash2_draft.scope: Tree rounds of the GGUF target: the draft step's af4g64 image is quantized from the BF16 weights at load; the BF16 norms, convolution kernels and codebooks are bound as stored.
